verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Seer Agent answers natural-language questions about an application's telemetry. Its official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, triage issues and manage projects, but operating the product beyond question-answering depends on an external AI client connected through MCP rather than a native natural-language command interface. missing for 10: documented native natural-language commands that perform actions (triage, assign, configure) inside Sentry itself, detail on which operations Seer Agent can execute versus only answer, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
When scoped, tools automatically default to the constrained org/project and unnecessary discovery tools are hidden.
